verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only portal announcements, login tips, OHID sign-in and tax-site features, and the probes record robots.txt returning 403 on ohiosos.gov and the filing portal. Nothing in the pack shows any API, API versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
